channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chandler Parsons | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chandler Parsons from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tony Allen on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
“And then it was that was the focus and then you're rehab, you're rehab somewhere in LA. We look up you in Cabo. It was kind of weird and then it was coach, you know coach feels that that's your homeboy. He told the media, you know, we about to sign Chandler Parsons, he the best thing with an IQ like LeBron James. I said, what? Not no kicking it in Cabo at this time of the year. And so the fans and we was expecting, but I'm here to give you your flowers.”

Tony Allen on Chandler Parsons, May 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Chandler Parsons, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Because people don't know. I talked to Chandler Parsons probably twice in my life. I don't know how he would know that. But me and KP (Porzingis) have a good relationship. I don't know why people say otherwise.”

Luka Doncic on Chandler Parsons, Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 4, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: David Fizdale on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Peter Edmiston:David Fizdale, on whether Chandler Parsons is a 4 now:

“Yeah, for the most part, but in certain situations I'll still use him as a 3,if I want to play bigger on the wing. But if he and J-Myke are on the floor, J-Myke takes the toughest matchup, Chandler defends another guy.”

David Fizdale on Chandler Parsons, Oct 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @peteredmiston.

item.title: Mike Conley on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Conley on Parsons after playing last week:

“I was very encouraged when he came down the middle of the lane and dunked on about two people.”

Mike Conley on Chandler Parsons, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Griffin told ESPN this week.

“We were concerned what would it look like for him because Kyrie had been really active with us in recruiting everybody that was going to come if LeBron didn't come. And was very successful as a recruiter. [Gordon] Hayward wanted to come, Chandler Parsons would have come, Channing Frye would have come, Trevor Ariza would have come. Like, we had an opportunity to get everybody, and he had done a great job for us. So there was a little bit of trepidation on our part of, 'Is he going to feel like we've asked him to go backwards?' And from the very beginning, it was like, 'Griff, all I want to do is win.' So he's been very receptive to it.”

David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons, Jun 1, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike Conley on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Exit -Mike Conley on offseason:

“Chandler Parsons is a major piece. We can't overlook that. Our No. 1 goal is to get him healthy.”

Mike Conley on Chandler Parsons, Apr 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: David Fizdale on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Fizdale said with a smirk before adding:

“Personally, I blame Chandler for everything that went wrong. I’m kidding because I know people are going to say crap like that.”

David Fizdale on Chandler Parsons, Mar 16, 2017. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Chris Wallace on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
General Manager Chris Wallace said.

“Chandler has the full support of myself, Coach Fizz and the entire team and we are all focused on getting him healthy.”

Chris Wallace on Chandler Parsons, Mar 13, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons:

“I'm glad he's playing. I hope he sucks tonight, but knowing our luck, he'll go for 50.”

Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons, Nov 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
On the loss of free agent Chandler Parsons:Cuban:

“I'm still good friends with Chandler. We talked about it after he signed with Memphis. We exchanged texts and stayed friends and committed to stay friends. I like him a lot but there were other things other than basketball that went into the decision. And Chandler was aware of them and he made his decision. We gave him some options and he went in a different direction. That was his choice and I respect it and again, I think he's a great guy and I hope he has a great season other than the four games we play him.”

Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons, Jul 24, 2016. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Chris Wallace on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Memphis GMChris Wallace on risk of Chandler Parsons' knee problems:

“We don't see it as taking a chance at all. If we weren't 100 percent sold on Chandler, we wouldn't be having this news conference today. We have all the faith in the world in his ability to rehab and stay healthy and provide us just a level of talent and versatility with his size on the perimeter that we haven't had in the past.”

Chris Wallace on Chandler Parsons, Jul 8, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Devin Harris on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Devin Harris on Chandler Parsons' likely pending free agency:

“I've talked to him a little bit. ... Not really sure where his mind is at.”

Devin Harris on Chandler Parsons, Jun 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Donnie Nelson:

“We'd certainly like to have Parsons continue his stint with the Mavericks. He's a young player with upside.”

Donnie Nelson on Chandler Parsons, Apr 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki on Parsons:

“The last 2 1/2 months he was playing some of the best ball of his career. ... It's another step back for him.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons, Mar 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle:

“We're disappointed that [Parsons] has the injury, but I can't really say anything other than what's in our release.”

Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons, Mar 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Wesley Matthews on Chandler Parsons:

“You lose one of your better players to something so fluky like that, obviously, we're all hurting for him.”

Wesley Matthews on Chandler Parsons, Mar 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Carlisle made it clear that the decision to play Parsons or Felton down the stretch will continue to be a game-by-game call as Parsons progresses in his comeback from hybrid microfracture surgery on his right knee.

“We don’t have any set finishing lineup, and I think it’s unfair to say Parsons is definitely a closer when he’s not really 100 percent there yet,”

Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons, Jan 20, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Dwain Price:DeAndre on his relationship with Parsons:

“It’s cool. I don’t really have a lot of relationships with other guys on other teams anyway.”

DeAndre Jordan on Chandler Parsons, Nov 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Tim Cato:Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons:

“I wouldn't be surprised if he played point. He may not start there, but he'll see a lot of time.”

Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons, Jul 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk on Parsons as a recruiter:

“He's great at small talking and all the stuff I'm not great at, so I'll let him do that stuff.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons, Apr 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Carlisle on Parsons:

“Any time surgery enters the equation, it's not a good thing. I talked to him today. He's extremely disappointed.”

Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons, Apr 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons:

“You look at who he is as a player first, then you say, ‘OK, how are you going to get him? What happens to everybody else on the roster if we don’t get a player like that.’ If you just take him completely out of the equation, OK we have the team that we have. Maybe we have (Shawn Marion) and Vince (Carter) back. That’s the same team. We haven’t gotten any younger and now we’re in the position we’re even older and how are we going to get there? We always have our backs against the wall in how are we going to solve that problem? While some people said, ‘OK, well you paid too much’ … By the time this new TV comes up, he’s going to look cheap.”

Mark Cuban on Chandler Parsons, Oct 30, 2014. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Bryan Gutierrez:Carlisle on Parsons’ game:

“He’s going to be fine. I like an awful lot of things that he did do. It’s one game.”

Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons, Oct 29, 2014. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
#Mavs FDirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons:

“He really takes our offensive game to another level. He’s going to be fun to watch.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Chandler Parsons, Oct 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
“I’ve received my punishment. My wife and daughter became full-time Chandler Parsons Twitter and Instagram followers.”

Rick Carlisle on Chandler Parsons, Oct 13, 2014. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jae Crowder on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
During frequent pickup games this summer, Crowder has been impressed with the defensive abilities of Chandler.

“I’ve been playing pickup with Chandler for two weeks and he’s one of the best defensive guys I’ve ever played with,”

Jae Crowder on Chandler Parsons, Sep 23, 2014. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: James Harden on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
“Chandler and I have had plenty of conversations, especially lately. Everything has been overblown. I’m happy for Chandler. He’s in a great situation. I wish nothing but the best of luck for him.”

James Harden on Chandler Parsons, Aug 10, 2014. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: James Harden on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
“I never said anything about Chandler. Chandler is in Dallas right now. I was just talking about my teammates. No matter what, if the Rockets are playing good, Dwight and James get the praise. If we’re doing bad, Dwight and James gets the bulk of criticism. The media, I guess, took another story and ran with it. Chandler and me are cool. We’re good.”

James Harden on Chandler Parsons, Jul 31, 2014. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Compliments aside, there's a reason Houston declined to match the Mavs' offer to Parsons.

“The contract (Parsons) got...the Mavericks are a smart organization; they obviously wanted to get him...that structure of that (contract) is literally one of the most untradeable structures I've ever seen,”

Daryl Morey on Chandler Parsons, Jul 14, 2014. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Mark Berman:Pat Beverley:

“I spoke to (Chandler) that day he signed the offer sheet with Dallas. He was hyped. I spoke to him at 5:30 this morning (in Taiwan) and he told me they are not going to match. Of course it's tough. I'm human. Chandler is like a brother to me. Me and Chandler were like the glue that kept it together. It's time 4me to step up 2the plate, provide more offensively and defensively to help our team. I'm confident. I think Dwight's confident. I think James is confident that we'll get some key pieces and try to make a run at this”

Patrick Beverley on Chandler Parsons, Jul 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
